description: This file defines a PHP class 'AdmonitionBlock' which extends an abstract block class, representing an admonition element in a Markdown content type. It encapsulates the properties and methods related to that block, specifically handling its type and optional title.

classes.name: AdmonitionBlock
classes.description: A class representing an admonition block in Markdown, with properties for type and optional title, and methods to access these.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an 'AdmonitionBlock' with a specified type and optional title.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the admonition block.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the optional title paragraph of the admonition block.
